concepts.title: Adolescence: A Stage of Growth and Change
concepts.definition: Between childhood and adulthood lies adolescence, the growing years when the body shoots up, the voice deepens or the figure changes, and the mind begins asking its own questions.
concepts.key_idea: Adolescence is a bridge: crossed with knowledge and support, it leads safely to adulthood.

concepts.title: Physical and Emotional Changes
concepts.section: Changes in the body and mind
concepts.definition: Adolescence brings visible physical changes, height, hair, skin and voice, and quieter emotional ones, mood swings, new feelings, self-consciousness; both are normal signs of the body maturing.
concepts.key_idea: Change is the plan, not a problem: knowing the map of changes removes the fear of them.

concepts.title: Hygiene, Diet and Balanced Living
concepts.definition: Growing bodies need support: a nourishing diet rich in protein, iron and calcium, daily hygiene to manage sweat and skin changes, exercise and enough sleep keep the adolescent years healthy.
concepts.key_idea: Care matches growth: what you eat, clean and move today builds the adult of tomorrow.

concepts.title: Asking the Why of Adolescence
concepts.definition: Hormones, chemical messengers of the body, drive the changes of adolescence; asking why, as the chapter does, replaces rumour with science and teaches respect for one's own growing body and for others.
concepts.key_idea: Understanding the why turns embarrassment into awareness: hormones are biology, not shame.
